name: Bunker Helix:
signature_source_text: Bunker Helix: Dozer1 → Power. Dozer2 → nearest supply. After Power: Dozer2-supply → Supply Center; Dozer1 → Barracks. When Supply done → AF beside it; when Rax done → 5 THs, send that dozer to another supply. AF done → Helix + Bunker upgrade, load 5 THs. Save → WF. Sell CC for a fast WF. Ground support essential; watch AA.

name: Dual War:
signature_source_text: Dual War: BM from each of 2 WFs — one middle, one flank. If you see his flank BM at the same time he likely went dual too → keep making BMs at his supplies, pick off dozers. No early units seen = he went Helix → make a Gatt from each WF down each flank + 2 more Gatts in your base corners to catch the Helix, then 2 more BMs.
